AI Image to Video Creator — Initial Release

- Instantly convert three JPG product photos into a 1080p MP4 video clip using simple text prompts.
- Automatic cloud GPU processing—upload images, describe your result, and get a downloadable video in under a minute.
- Handles authentication and session setup (up to 100 free credits, 7-day expiry) with clear user feedback.
- Supports quick edits, batch workflows, and iterative timeline refinements through easy chat commands.
- Export to multiple formats (mp4, mov, gif, jpg, etc.); max file size 200MB.
- Guides user with prompt-based actions for uploading, status, credits, and exports—no video editing experience required.
